verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only human-facing online services: web filing portals, a fax-filing application, email and text notices, and a Premier Business Services account that gives frequent filers shared payment and staff access. Nothing documents a system-to-system channel such as an API, system accounts, a transmitter program or batch-provider enrollment. The PBS account is an adjacent convenience feature for frequent human filers, not a machine rail, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
